notes.title: Short Weekly Update #115
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow entrepreneurs! 🤗⭐[/p][p]We are not releasing a new update today, as many of the changes and additions below require thorough testing. A small number of fixes and quality improvements have been applied in the game and will come out next week, and we've also made big progress on Achievements, which led to cloud saves being activated.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]There are only 100 achievements which we were able to add due to current Steam limits; Steam still treats this game as a 'fake game'. Therefore, we cannot go above 100 at the moment. Cloud saving is now enabled for achievement progress to sync across devices.[/p][/*][*][p]We implemented some minor balancing this week, such as marketing cost was reduced by 50% to make early promotion more accessible and to prepare for AI competition. Additionally, we increased the vehicle upgrade capacity. Every vehicle gained one extra upgrade slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold storage upgrade was streamlined. Now you can upgrade directly to the next tier; no need to buy an extra storage and sell the old one as previously required. [/p][/*][/list][h3]New features and improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Research UI now shows progress on tier titles and on each category header, so players do not get stuck if they miss a research in a tier.[/p][/*][*][p]In the News section, the missing "Okay" button that was supposed to appear to acknowledge the event is now back, giving you enough time to read. Sorry, that was missed last time. And now the auto-advance option is available for those who prefer it.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Input fallback was added to reset held-keys when a key-release is missed. According to a community bug report: ordering is always changing by 5x. This aims to resolve that odd behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Cash event bug fixed: A "last 7-day" protection was not blocking all cash events from repeating within a 7-day period. This was fixed. Now, within seven in-game days, only one cash event can occur, as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold storage capacity duplication on vehicle upgrade fixed. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]UI shake regression cleaned up. Repeated shakes no longer shift the UI out of place. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]Expiring ingredients label now updates correctly between day and night. No more confusion on the expiring ingredients. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]Goal Completed text and VFX formatting fixed to make the text legible on both light and dark modes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Achievements sneak peek: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/274dd02ee862fd0b05e380daf1b6fe1f80d179a9.png"][/img][/p][p]That is it for this week. As always, your reports help us tune the balance and find edge cases. Keep them coming.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Follow the journey![/b] Join our community here: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/HpDZM7v"]https://discord.gg/HpDZM7v[/url][/p][p][url="https://businessheroes.m-pages.com/GwNkYz/business-heroes-website"]https://businessheroes.m-pages.com/GwNkYz/business-heroes-website[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Live long and prosper 👋

notes.title: Short Weekly Update #114
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! ⭐🙋🏻[/p][p]Apologies for the gap in posts. Updates were paused to fix critical build bugs and complete a quality check on new mechanics. This is a significant drop that incorporates the recent changes from the past few weeks.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]We did a full review of the game’s event system with fixes across branding, economy, and probability events.[/p][/*][*][p]We revamped the End-of-Day report with performance review, new UI, and fixed localisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera and UI polish continues, storage overflow feedback is clearer, and tutorial guidance is sharper.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New features and improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Capacity feedback on ordering screen: storage percentage(%) now changes colour as capacity fills. Ordering tooltips now show storage capacity and warnings. A sound effect and a shake plays each time stock will go to waste due to over-capacity (120% or above). The sound is rate-limited, and only triggers from manual clicks on the Manage Ordering plus button and the Calculate button.[/p][/*][*][p]Goal completion visibility improvements: corrected text formatting in the Goal Completed effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Research guidance: a pretty big cursor tracker in the Research tab remains; the count of unlocked research is hidden to reduce clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Events tab quality of life: Esc clears the overlay after completing a news event. The overlay also clears automatically in the morning if still visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Histogram in End of Day report: Career day histogram submissions are now stored in the database for analysis and public ranking. We require at least 10 data points to rank players. Each player can save only one data point per country.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]End of Day report: what changed and why. (Special thanks to Zach Barth)[/h3][p]The goal was to turn the End of Day report into a clear performance review that rewards good play and to guide players on where to improve.[/p][p]What is new[/p][list][*][p]Performance review panels: three deep-dive views covering Price Management, Stock Management, and Customer Satisfaction. Each view includes metrics, rank, and guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance ratings will be used in future versions to allocate experience points, which will then be utilized for the research tree as research boosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Milestones: confetti now celebrates milestones reached that day in the End of Day sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]Visuals and audio: themed UI applied across the new panels, popup alignment improved, progress circles animate on fill, and the “Best” mark size reduced to fit cleanly in the End of Day report.[/p][/*][/list][p]Work in progress:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/2f2a1a8676a0ee13976a96a5e1e969b6400dd311.png"][/img]Research Unlocked and Expired Ingredients are now displayed as pop-ups next to the main section of the End of Day report. The histograms at the bottom of the view will be populated once we have enough data points on the server. To help increase the data points, please invite your friends to play, as each player can contribute only one data point per country. And the system will always keep the best value for each player. Thanks to Zach Barth for the assistance in building this system.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/1bf3e8f557ddee0627b1271400862450b6ddce57.png"][/img]Customer satisfaction measures the ratio of positive feedback to negative feedback, excluding any feedback categorized as too expensive. This will keep players focused on customer satisfaction. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/2a589a038f8fd3c5fbdb60282460c66245554bcd.png"][/img]Effective price management is vital for deepening the understanding of the dynamics between demand and supply. A price survey can reveal the price customers are inclined to pay for a product; however, it overlooks the demand that this specified price will generate. Often, the demand sparked by the "desired" price point can significantly surpass the standard supply or capacity available. This section delves into this critical issue, providing guidance for players on how to strategically adjust prices. By doing so, they can attain an optimal queue size, enhancing both customer satisfaction and operational efficiency through thoughtful pricing strategies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/fe58a83372cd91f44105743076844429f9ff2048.png"][/img]Storage management is another critical factor, as players often run out of stock well before the end of the day, sometimes as early as 6 hours before closing. To encourage better storage practices, we introduced a reward system for efficient storage management. Items will only expire if you don’t have a fridge, which means that ordering enough ingredients to meet daily sales should be easy for those with a fridge. If a stand’s capacity is utilized to at least 80% of max capacity and all items are sold, players will be rewarded for effective storage management. Storage Efficiency = (Used Storage Space ÷ 80% of Total Available Storage Space), where Used Storage Space is the difference between space used at the start of the day and space used at the end of the day. [/p][p]Please give it a try and let us know what you think. [/p][p][/p][h3]Events overhaul: two-week focused pass[/h3][p]The objective was to resolve correctness, permanence, localisation, and activation order across all event.[/p][p]What was reviewed[/p][list][*][p]Appearance and population base happiness events.[/p][/*][*][p]Branding events.[/p][/*][*][p]GDP and interest rate events.[/p][/*][*][p]Cash and permit fee events.[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase probability and segment size events.[/p][/*][/list][p]Key fixes and changes[/p][list][*][p]Activation and permanence[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where only the last active event was reactivated when loading a save. Multiple permanent events are now restored correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected GDP events that should be permanent and ensured day-duration settings are added when events are non-permanent.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Clean Event function on deactivation for events that target stands or employees to avoid errors if a stand is sold during an event.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored event modifiers on deactivation, where removal could strip permanent effects incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added flags for event stages so late-game days continue with the last included stage beyond the end day.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Branding logic[/p][list][*][p]Replaced a single GlobalCompanyBrandModifier with a list that supports DistrictTypes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added utilities to resolve stand-specific and locality-specific branding.[/p][/*][*][p]Branding events can now pick a locality based on a random stand’s position for better spread.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Economy and rates[/p][list][*][p]Interest rate tooltip variables now render with the correct colours.[/p][/*][*][p]Zero-sum permanent interest events no longer show zeroed values in effects.[/p][/*][*][p]GDP events now match descriptions and timing, including fixed duration flags.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cash and fees[/p][list][*][p]Added appropriate research requirements to gate some cash research.[/p][/*][*][p]News overlay: Esc to clear after an event; auto-clear in the morning if still visible.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: sprite formatting corrected in Goal Completed text; tooltip offsets now notes.content:
[p]Hello CEOs! 🤗[/p][p]This week we focused on camera and zoom polish, UI clarity, and a few balance changes.[/p][h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Zoom is smoother and now follows the cursor position.[/p][/*][*][p]Viewport expand and collapse keeps the current zoom level where possible and no longer jitters.[/p][/*][*][p]National Landmark hover effects scale correctly when workers.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fast Forward rapid click no longer causes the game to lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Invalid characters in company names no longer block log file creation.[/p][/*][/list][h3]In Development[/h3][list][*][p]Purchase probability effects: customers passing through a stand’s range will briefly show their chance to buy.[/p][/*][*][p]New research tracks:[/p][list][*][p]Promotion: Online, Radio, TV, Light Magic, six customer segment filters[/p][/*][*][p]Stand and Speed: Cash Register, Wireless Freedom, Nitro Booster[/p][/*][*][p]Team and Queue: Grill Master, Ice Blower, Sun Blower, Super HD Surround, Super Nova[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Unified layout for load and save screens across the game.[/p][/*][*][p]GDP events: missing variables after the recent localisation pass addressed for a future build.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooling: log browser updated to display currencies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Development roadmap[/h2][p][/p][p]We are still estimating the date of release for these updates, but this is roughly what to expect for the next 6 months.[/p][list][*][p][b]Stat Snapshots[/b] – End Of Day screen will show 3 histograms for burgers sold, profit margin, and goals completed, so you can size yourself up against other players playing in the same country. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Log Tab[/b] – A running feed of every event, tweak, and surprise that hits your business and the city, all in one place.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements[/b] - 101 different achievements [/p][/*][*][p][b]Swinging Ingredient Prices[/b] – Each week prices jump anywhere from −50 percent to +50 percent, with a handy pop-up showing the changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Timed Goals[/b] – Every goal set by Master Lee gets a clear deadline, bigger rewards, and story links that chain small wins into the next challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Business Nudge[/b] – Master Lee will popup to suggest different strategies and how to improve your business, grow and navigate hard times. For example, taking a loan if you want growth instead of saving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sharper Goals and Expansion[/b]– Cleaner goal briefs, explicit fail-states, and new Large-sized business goals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two-Tier Research[/b] – Research will be Experience Points (XP) based instead of time based. notes.title: October Dev Diary - Thanks for Playing!
notes.content:
Hey, heroes! 👋

Steam Next Fest is over, and we want to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who played the demo and also those who took the time to create content during the event! We were blown away by the excitement and the awesome feedback you shared. Your support means everything to us.

And for those who missed it or can’t get enough, you'll be happy to know that the demo will stay live until further notice! 🎉 

So, jump back in, explore the latest updates, and keep those insights coming. Speaking of updates, here are some of the improvements we made to the game this month:

[h2]Understanding the Numbers 🔢[/h2]
We rolled out detailed breakdowns for several key financial figures to help players better understand what really drives their business's core numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5f985c2778d4f2ee4adfeb99134c5ca30e424128.png[/img]

Hopefully, these insights would help players manage their resources more effectively and make decisions that could significantly improve their operations, offering a clearer picture of where to increase efficiencies or cut costs.

[h2]What’s the Story? 🤔[/h2]
The demo now begins with an engaging introductory scene from Master Lee sharing his quest for a successor. From starting with a single food truck to becoming a business mogul, Master Lee's story sets the stage for the player's journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/e10956d7f66143216675192256868b5b8381a9ef.gif[/img]

[h2]Day Zero Access to Inventory Calculator 🧮[/h2]
One feedback we encountered repeatedly throughout the fest was to improve the ordering process. Consequently, we made the inventory calculator readily accessible from [b]day zero[/b] and removed it from the list of researchable items.

To keep things interesting, it’s now available on a pay-per-use basis, and the fee is based on the total cost of inventory orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/81c5e86e5c26ac9b68bd414b227d5a662a6571bf.gif[/img]

While this adjustment speeds up the ordering process right from the start, its cost component also adds a pinch of financial spice, encouraging players to strategize their pennies as wisely as their patties.

[h2]Zooming In on the Action 🔍[/h2]
This was another big one from the event! We heard loud and clear that it's important to get a closer look at the actual buying and selling activity during the day. We've now added a zoom functionality that allows players zoom in to see more details or pull back for a full view of the action. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/4e6b480b67fb5c28acc9e963a73052dedd25fd83.gif[/img]

[h2]Recipe Tip 📋[/h2]
A number of players also struggled to complete the basic recipe goal because the quantity requirements weren’t as memorable as we thought. To improve this, we implemented a friendly tip that pops up when players get close to the goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9faa9b52677027f9971ef887b386684bfef96284.gif[/img]

That's it October! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our mailing list[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: September Dev Diary - Countdown to the Demo
notes.content:
Hey, heroes! 👋

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who participated in our Open Beta! Your feedback has been nothing short of amazing, and it’s helping us improve the game. 

But before we get into the latest updates, let’s talk about what’s right around the corner...

[h1]Demo Coming in Hot on October 4th! 🎮[/h1]
That's right! [b]Mark your calendars[/b] because the Steam Demo is just a few days away! 🤯 Whether you missed the Beta or are itching for more, this is another opportunity to explore the game and experience all the new features we’ve been working on.

Here’s what you can expect from the demo:[list]
[*] [b]7 Markets[/b] 🌎: Test your strategy skills in diverse markets, including the USA, China, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Russia, and South Korea.
[*] [b]3 Localities[/b] 📍: Grow your business across Noisy Playground, Street Corner, and Big Station.
[*] [b]15 Days of Gameplay[/b] 🗓️: You’ll have two in-game weeks to reach Master Lee’s ambitious profit targets.
[*] [b]Tiered Research Options[/b] 🔬: Unlock new capabilities and refine your business strategies with access to both Tier 1 and Tier 2 research opportunities.
[*] [b]Events[/b] 📰: Face real-world challenges with Level 1 and Level 2 events that will put your decision-making skills to the test.
[*] [b]Promotion Mechanics[/b] 📲: Attract more customers with pamphlets and social media advertising.
[*] [b]Basic Banking[/b] 🏦: Secure small loans with a basic bank account
[/list]Get ready for a fine business challenge because this demo is bringing all the heat! 🔥

Now, let’s get into some of the exciting improvements we've made based on your recommendations.

[h2]Incremental UI Reveals[/h2]
One of the key pieces of feedback we received from the Beta was that, while the UI has greatly improved, it still felt overwhelming for many players, especially in the early stages of the game.

In response, we’ve introduced conditional visibility to ease players into the experience. On your first night in business, you’ll notice a cleaner, more streamlined interface. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/04446ebcf301e919bff25a3f4e23439fce125f4d.png[/img]
We’ve hidden non-essential elements initially to prevent overload.

[h3]How it works[/h3]
As you complete Master Lee’s early goals, additional UI components will progressively unlock, allowing you to discover more complex aspects of the game gradually.

For example, here's how the research tree is revealed after the ordering task is completed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ddf7dd3116f509d8f8eea85b0790655211b32e16.gif[/img]
Hopefully, this method, paired with the navigational guide and goals system, will gently guide you into the game's deeper complexities, ensuring each phase of discovery feels manageable and engaging.

[h2]Meet Your New Research Guide: Grace![/h2]
Speaking of research, A common challenge we noticed was players struggling to prioritize projects and locate unlocked items. To tackle this, we’ve introduced [b]Grace[/b], Master Lee’s trusted research assistant, to guide you through the research selection process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/548b56902045de566c2aa5c0f7366f3fb497e5ee.png[/img]
Grace provides useful recommendations to help you make the best decisions on which research projects to prioritize for success.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5e9e755c3970ac5d737377e1ed031be195021605.gif[/img]
Grace also explains the purpose of each research item and points you directly to where it’s located once unlocked. For example, here’s her visual guidance for finding [b]Service Insights[/b] after you've unlocked it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/29652e6c6daf23f6c9bb00f1eeed9f6c6f5edd98.png[/img]
[h2]New Ways to Target Customers[/h2]
We also recognized a need to improve how players cater to the different customer groups. We've now added upgrades that allow you to attract specific customer groups while discouraging others. 3 of these upgrades will be available in the demo: 

[h3]Student Saver[/h3]
Adjust your menu to offer budget-friendly choices for students. This upgrade not only attracts students but subtly diminishes the stand's appeal to other customer groups who might be looking for more premium options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/f27027bcc90a03805e21dfc755794bf010f10f82.png[/img]
[h3]Toy Giveaway[/h3]
Keep parents happy and kids entertained by offering a free toy with each meal. This upgrade makes your stand a hit among families looking to enjoy a meal without the usual fuss from the little ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/7d1a9a4e70f611623f357df08af7363a6ed4b117.png[/img]
[h3]Quick Serve[/h3]
Speed is the game for busy workplace professionals. By ensuring your service is swift, you make your stand the go-to spot for a quick lunch break, reducing wait times for Staff and increasing turnover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9794d8859f2f909b5b4a83ba25af600dd082bc1d.png[/img]
These upgrades allow you to mix and match strategies based on the type of customers you want to attract, giving you even more control over your business.

That's it for September! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our mailing list[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: August Dev Diary - Beta Days Ahead
notes.content:
Hey, heroes! 👋

We've got some delicious updates to share with you this month. From the much-anticipated Open Beta announcement to significant strides in our tutorial system and gameplay mechanics, August has been a tasty mix of progress and excitement.

So grab your favorite snack (burgers, anyone? 🍔), and let's get into the latest developments!

[h1]Open Beta in September! 😍[/h1]
Yes, you read that right! After months of hard work and countless iterations, we're ecstatic to announce that a [i][b]limited[/b][/i] Open Beta will be live from [b]September 13th to 15th[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/f8436a7700eec5c1e4f5c6ebdb8ff7153caf03bf.png[/img]
This is your chance to experience the latest version of the game with all the new features, and give us your valuable feedback before the demo release in October.

But there's a catch. 😉

Slots are limited, and keys are flying out the door on a first-come, first-serve basis. If you haven't requested beta access in the last two weeks, [url=http://eepurl.com/hL3Qvv]sign up now to register[/url].

Our goals for this playtest are simple:[list]
[*] Gather your feedback to fine-tune the gameplay.
[*] Iron out any hiccups before the official demo.
[*] Build a stronger connection with our amazing community—you!
[/list]We [i]absolutely[/i] can't wait to have you onboard and hear your thoughts! 

Now, onto the exciting behind-the-scenes work we've been doing.

[h2]Tutorial System Design Challenges[/h2]
Designing a tutorial for a strategy game is no walk in the park, especially when you’re trying to satisfy both [b]Achievers[/b] who crave structured guidance and [b]Explorers[/b] who love to discover things on their own. To strike the right balance, we created a two-part onboarding system that that caters to both styles of play.

[h3]Navigational Guide[/h3]
First, we implemented a skippable navigational guide to help new players get familiar with the game’s interface. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/2b22b4d071766eca6a4360ab4b0e3ba5f82a5db4.jpg[/img]
We know how overwhelming a strategy game UI can be, especially when you're first starting out, so this guide aims to make that initial learning curve a bit smoother. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/dd3dbf5aa8bab8a431e00e6554649d4cbf987fd8.jpg[/img]
However, for those of you who love diving straight into the action, you can skip this guide right from the get-go.

[h3]Gameplay Discovery[/h3]
Next, Instead of handholding you through each mechanic, we set mini-goals and provide tips that help you discover the game's mechanics by doing. Completing these challenges will earn you experience points that can be used to unlock items in the research tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9356004480a5d5994004983276d93055594e9e8d.png[/img]
We believe this method works exceptionally well for tycoon and management game players, as it mirrors the decision-making and strategic planning that are core to the gameplay.

[h3]Core Considerations[/h3]
While building this tutorial, we've kept three key considerations at the forefront: player autonomy, a rewarding experience, and clarity. We want you to feel empowered to discover the game your way, with just enough guidance and meaningful rewards.

[h2]New Game Setup Screen[/h2]
We’ve also overhauled the game setup screen to give it a fresh, spacious layout with a more vibrant color palette. Here's how the previous version looked:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c03be0342e5bb03d6fb58acb5ccf07511b74e417.png[/img] 
In the latest version, essential elements like weather conditions, starting funds, GDP, and interest rates are now prominently displayed, giving you a clearer sense of how they’ll impact your game’s difficulty. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9c2fbb87dbdaf76f4f272b0ae9943a30cff1f4e2.gif[/img]

Additionally, the new difficulty gauge resolves a previous usability issue where players attempted to adjust the difficulty setting by interacting directly it.

[h2]Preventing Unintended Consequences[/h2]
Another QoL improvement we made was to implement informative pop-ups that help prevent unintended consequences. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/85e3f12110450d3bf481bdf4608ef65eecee1825.gif[/img]
Whether you’re tweaking a recipe after placing an inventory order or starting a new research queue, these pop-ups will now warn you of any potential impacts on your strategy. 

This way, you can make informed decisions and avoid any unintentional slip-ups.

[h2]Discarding Inventory[/h2]
A longstanding pain point we've seen during gameplay has been the management of surplus ingredients that take up more storage space than necessary.

Previously, the only solutions were to either incorporate surplus items into recipes where they didn't really belong or to cease ordering them altogether, hoping to balance the stock manually over time.

Neither approach was particularly satisfying or realistic.

To address this, we've implemented a new 'Discard Inventory' function that allows you to delete either a portion or the entirety of any ingredient that's cluttering your storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/6aa1b90721065e8117b77c86b8a6a2e7450cf365.gif[/img] 

That's it for August! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our mailing list[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: June Dev Diary - Event System 2.0
notes.content:
Hey, heroes! 👋

This month was "[i]event revamp[/i]" month, as we took time to redesign the game's Events system...again. For a quick refresher on how the system worked before, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1429080/view/3727334116172593602]read this[/url]. 👈

Done reading? Okay, let's get into the changes.

[h2]Why the Redesign? 🤔[/h2]
The addition of the research system, which drives the progressive unlocking of various aspects of your business, introduced a crucial mismatch with the existing Events logic.

Suddenly, we had events triggering changes to areas of the business that had not been researched yet, causing significant confusion (to put it mildly). 😮

Clearly, we had to fix that. 😂

[h2]Redesign Goals 🎯[/h2]
Our goal was twofold: 
[olist]
[*] Ensure that events only impact researched aspects of the company. 
[*] Do the above while avoiding monotony and maintaining a fun/rewarding challenge. 
[/olist]
Easy-peasy…or maybe not. We are still trying to solve the second part. 🤣

Anyways, the following is how the new events system currently works. It’s still in development and will be finalized after some rigorous testing.

[h2]New Design ⚒️[/h2]
For the new design, we’ve:
[list]
[*] Expanded the levels of events.
[*] Eliminated the news selection option.
[*] Introduced a more structured approach to how events unfold.
[/list]Here’s how.
[h3]Stage-Based Dynamics[/h3] 
The events are now divided into different stages based on in-game days. This makes more sense since the research is equally tied to game days. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/082836724dab1822bd6681a939cbc9d21b50c80d.png[/img]

[h3]Event Levels & Types 👍👎[/h3] 
The system now features six levels of positive and negative events. Each level unlocks as you progress through the milestones. The event level indicates the severity of the in-game impact, both positively and negatively.

For instance, a level 2 positive event will be less impactful in terms of effect and/or duration than a level 5 or 6 positive event.

This is the current event level distribution across the event stages:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/0f3c8318667312e9fa9ac6c4c1eb0215e4fc00b5.png[/img]

As you progress through the game-day milestones, you’ll face an increasing mix of event severity, challenging you with more complex scenarios.

[h3]Event Probabilities⚖️[/h3] 
We have also modified the probabilities of positive, negative, and no events occurring at each game stage. 

The graph below shows the current probability distribution for each type of event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/484de8fd661e0603ac7d4e795f6b823df11b65ed.gif[/img]
Stage 1 starts with a higher probability of positive and no events occurring. Over time, negative events increase to push out no-event instances until a balance is reached at stage 6.

We will keep you posted on any improvements and changes as we roll the system into testing. 

[h2]New Improvements 🪴[/h2]
[b]Research Unlock Voiceovers[/b]: We've added voiceovers to many research items to provide essential context and guidance upon unlocking them. The system also includes playback controls and scrolling text for improved accessibility.

And for those who absolutely can't stand voiceovers interrupting their flow, we added a mute button for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8984f2d1dc3bb0696cedfcdfef0f0631d33ac4dd.gif[/img]

[b]Self-managed Stands[/b]: You now manage your first stand personally from day one. This means early savings on worker salaries and bonuses until you unlock management capabilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9d85b197838b35910eaf022c72aa3445be9ba6b0.gif[/img]

There might be a few limitations to managing your stand personally as your company grows. But the jury's still out on what those might be. 

Fingers crossed.😉

[b]Balance Sheet and Cashflow[/b]: In keeping with the rest of the UI, we've split the balance sheet and cashflow statement into separate tabs. 

We also tweaked the presentation a bit to give it that extra accounting flair. Hopefully, all ye number crunchers would love the new look. 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8f1b329ebf7321b42fea20d6691fbccc356a279c.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐞[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the CEO's 🧑‍💼 name would cause an error when the game tried to access unavailable company information.
[*] Stopped the game from incorrectly trying to get multiplayer data for workers while in single-player mode. 🎮
[*] Fixed an error that occurred when the game tried to create the end-of-day report 📄 while research for tier 2 items was still ongoing.
[*] Fixed several variables 🔢 in the customer feedback tooltips.
[*] Resolved a problem affecting uninitialized research elements when the player doesn't open the research tab after starting the game. 🧩
[*] Stopped all non-interactable buttons from being highlighted. 🚫
[*] Fixed an accounting error affecting burger ingredient 🍅 🥬 purchase after buying a stand.
[*] Stopped research connection lines from being redrawn at runtime.
[*] Fixed an issue where translated monologue text defaulted back to the local database, resulting in English monologues. 💬
[*] Expired stock 🧀 is now correctly accounted for in cash flow accounting.
[*] Resolved game-breaking bugs related to the events system. 🗞️
[*] Stopped the music player 🎼 from crashing the game when switching back to the main menu.
[*] Resolved an override affecting random stands when worker-related events are generated.
[*] Fixed a bug causing a switch to the recipe view when the player has yet to select a stand.
[/list]
That's it for June! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: May Dev Diary - End of Day Report, Research Progress, and Money Management
notes.content:
Hey, heroes! 👋

Welcome to our dev diary for May. Considering we didn't post one for April, we couldn't resist getting you all caught up with an extra-large serving of updates this month. 

So grab a burger...or two (no judgment here), get comfy, and let the eye-feast begin!

[i]TLDR: We've introduced a detailed End-of-Day Report, integrated Dark Mode, modified the Accounting Summary display, progressed the Research Tree, and made significant strides in Money Management implementation![/i]

To see live gameplay containing many of the following updates, watch me try to hit a $6,900 income target in 15 days:

[previewyoutube=BU3Z-pB9-qk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Dark Mode Integration 🌛[/h2]
As you are (most likely) aware, the game has a dark mode feature because, let’s face it, everything looks cooler in the dark. We’ve been integrating the dark theme into the latest version of the game while also making UI improvements. 

Here’s how the UI looked while it was a work in progress: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/869c7d71c50c3e9f8d8b5566fa71daf874ccb40e.jpg[/img]
Current look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/582a591132242d649524614c3c45cd58b3e1a03a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Accounting Summary Improvements 🗒️[/h2] 
The accounting summary at the bottom left of the UI provides a much-needed snapshot of your Stand’s performance per time. For many players, this will be their first and most frequently used financial dataset.

Given the importance of this section, we’ve improved the design to feature a side-by-side presentation of Income and Expenses, with Operating Income presented as a distinct figure. Yeah, we can hear all of you numbers nerds sighing in satisfaction all the way from here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/cb74d4a67e3d4e7e342cafb420ee45cb1aabb31c.png[/img]
[h2]End-of-Day Report 📃[/h2] 
One factor all successful companies share is a relentless focus on performance. The End of Day (EoD) report captures essential aspects of the just-concluded day and displays them in an easy-to-digest report.

When determining the report's content, we carefully selected metrics that provide a comprehensive view of the company's overall health, including financial performance, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and specific insights into daily operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/75379144f860b58ceb29fdfedd70651c661cd567.png[/img]
This was a bit tricky as we knew you'd most likely view this report in strategy optimization mode (nighttime), so we needed to ensure the data on display would be relevant regardless of your company's size and research stage.

Given that you will probably want to refer to the EoD report as your business grows, we made it easily accessible from the gameplay screen via a collapse/expand button. The report also delivers a notification about the status of your research as they are completed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/4994112215a491b5836cca125e59a6349288e665.gif[/img]
[h2]Research Tree Implementation 🎄[/h2] 
The research tree is sprouting nicely, gradually beginning to look like how we envisioned. Much of it is still in progress, so expect to be pleasantly surprised when it's fully grown.

This is the current state for Tier 1 research items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/92d46a1bd444ace28b4909804756afe8089db1e2.gif[/img]
Items can be researched individually, queued up, or prioritized over a research queue that's in progress. The number of days required for each research item and queue is also displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/b9c679ab4de046a4eca9dfd452958dccd3c82c80.gif[/img]
Depending on your research selection, notifications will appear in your End of Day report as the items become available.

[h2]Money Management 💰[/h2] 
The money view 🤑 is the umbrella section for Accounts, Statements, and Banking. The accounts section is still cooking, but the company and stand-level histories 🗓️ are already being processed quite well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/1ae379407d3054f4ca72114294911a2d43105368.gif[/img]
Detailed report at the company 🏢 level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/a43b56c04ebafe75992409caf2bf0a862528d35c.gif[/img]
And at the food stand 🚚 level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8c2ba8082bf6a34071362e7f11c7052bf0c65a85.gif[/img]
For the data visualizers in the house, your jam is definitely on our menu! The account section contains an assortment of graphs and charts. 📈📊

You’ll find detailed visuals on burger 🍔 and drink 🍹 sales, income, expenses, profit margin changes, and expense distribution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ead1f3cb0c3836403f99c3f8d7c1f5e183daf183.gif[/img]
All of which will be polished further as development continues.

[h2]Other Improvements ✨[/h2] 
[b]Ordering Animations[/b]: We've added animations to make the current burger count 🍔 and overstock notification ⚠️ more pronounced when ordering new ingredients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/a31030d645fd937583692fa02224346a959a3aa5.gif[/img]
[b]Goal Tracker[/b] 🎯: The base goal-tracker functionality has been implemented. Right now, it only tracks your total income. 💰 We will expand it in later versions to power the entire mission system.

[b]Language Settings[/b]: You can now change your language settings from the initial settings screen ⚙️ when the game loads.

[b]Upgrades Carry Over[/b]: All purchased upgrades carry over to your new Stand when you upgrade to (as opposed to buying) a new Stand. 🚚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/4b27f4421b37a6394cfbc41716dd2f30bed7de3e.gif[/img]
That's it for May! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

notes.title: March Dev Diary - New Tools, Navigation, & Localization
notes.content:
Hello Heroes! 👋

We marched through March, implementing updates to improve your gaming experience. From intuitive UI improvements to strategic tools, let’s explore the latest enhancements from our dev forge.

[i]TLDR: This March, we’ve refined the UI, introduced a new Stand menu, added a click-to-move feature for stands, expanded tooltips, launched the Pricing Survey, progressed on localization, and more![/i]

[h2]UI Improvements 📐[/h2]
For strategy games, simplifying a complex User Interface (UI) is essential to providing a memorable gaming experience. As a result, we have meticulously refined the alignment and layout of key UI elements within the Ordering, Pricing, Inventory, and Recipe sections. 

Also, we carried out comprehensive content reviews aimed at enhancing accessibility for a wider audience. We believe these improvements not only raise the visual and aesthetic coherence of the game but also significantly augment its overall usability.

[h2]New Menu for Stands 🚚[/h2] 
To enhance the efficiency of managing food trucks, we've introduced a new Stand menu, accessible directly from the environment view. This feature provides rapid access to all critical functions related to managing your stands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5e479c17ecf65e59133ae6a15d0e87ae641b08bb.gif[/img]
It also offers a forward-looking view by displaying the inventory available for sale the following day. Hopefully, the menu will help more players save time, allowing more focus on strategic decisions and less on interface navigation.

[h2]Move View for Empty Spots 📍[/h2] 
In the spirit of 'more time on strategy and less on navigation,' we also added a feature that allows players to move to an empty spot by clicking it. Previously, Stands could only be moved by clicking on them or using the move function on the User Interface. Now, players can start the stand movement process by clicking on an empty spot in the environment. 

[h2]More Tooltip Implementations💡[/h2] 
Recognizing the necessity for greater transparency in our game's mechanics, we have expanded the tooltip feature across critical areas such as vehicle upgrades, customer feedback, and recipe management. This ensures that players will be presented with immediate and clear insights by simply placing their cursor over any object.

[h2]The Pricing Survey is Live! 🎉[/h2] 
The Pricing Survey is one feature we are all excited about, as it provides an unparalleled understanding of customer pricing behaviour within the game. It is now fully operational, offering insights into how various customers will perceive different price points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/7e0efc7700cfa1629bce6de0c3f347b5a5f21ef5.gif[/img]
With this tool, players will be able to set competitive prices by making data-driven pricing decisions.

[h2]Localization Efforts 🌍[/h2] 
As part of our ongoing commitment to make the game globally accessible, we have made significant strides in our localization efforts. This latest phase focused on the meticulous translation and cultural adaptation of district hover menus, worker narratives, and all elements related to vehicle upgrades. 

Particularly challenging yet rewarding was the localization of workers' names and stories, which required careful consideration not only of language but also of cultural nuances. This process assures that the game resonates with diverse players, preserving the original wealth of the narrative across different languages and facilitating a deeper connection with the global gaming community.

[h2]Spotlight on the Ordering Section ✨[/h2] 
The Ordering section got some more love and attention this month. It now sports new visual effects (VFX) and improved component alignment for a more visually engaging presentation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/9f3f2e394b78f541a6bd9a34b571a1c0426dedb9.gif[/img]
Our goal is to enrich the overall interaction with the game, ensuring that even routine tasks provide a sense of satisfaction and engagement.

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐞[/h2] 
Finally, we have addressed several bugs plaguing the current version of the game. Some include:
- Rectification of the weather dropdown to guarantee accurate representation of daily weather changes.
- Resolution of performance issues previously impacting the Worker screen.
- Several fixes in our localization system.

That's it for March! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,

notes.title: February Dev Diary - Menus, Upgrades, and Sunrays
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 👋

February went by in a flurry of activities, with the team tackling everything from UI tweaks to gameplay enhancements. Let’s peel back the curtain on what’s been cooking in our game dev kitchen, shall we?

[i]TLDR: Hover menus are in, and they promise to delight all you info snackers. The top bar has got a new look, and customer pathing is probably the best it has ever been. Plus, bug fixes and more.[/i]

[h2]Hover Menus Ahoy! 🖱️[/h2]
We introduced the hover menus in City View to provide quick, easy access to relevant stats. This way, players can see the vitals of a locality without visiting it. On hover, essential details like population size, permit fees, how much money your stand is pulling in, etc., appear on the screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/b7ef08eb543ce469ec9fcbc12ac3e0fd542d0406.gif[/img]
Some data points will be hidden by default and only revealed when you hover over their related icons to manage the visual load. 

[h2]Top Bar & Pathing Improvements 🚶‍♂️[/h2] 
The top bar and our customer pathing system got some love, too:[list]
[*] Avatars and locality icons? They've hit the gym and are now bigger and bolder.
[*] Weather and temperature buttons are not just functional; they're animated and fun!
[*] Population stats are at your fingertips with a new dropdown menu.
[*] Better differentiation between current and forecasted weather in the weather dropdown.
[*] Finally, we fixed the pathing in all localities so customers no longer walk through food stands.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐛🔨[/h2] 
Amongst others, we tracked down a sneaky bug that kept inventory and cash balance from updating with each sale. It was hiding within our recent feedback system enhancements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c9ab58015c3e69fe15696b3dd2dc47f9eea8318b.gif[/img]
Thankfully, we fixed it, and we're back to business as usual.

[h2]Guiding Lights and Night Sights 🌞🌃[/h2] 
[b]Sun Rays for Stand Spots:[/b] We added these ethereal beams to showcase the stand spots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5153674b928ebe53c8b566f9021dcf494d8347e3.gif[/img]
This isn't just about making things look pretty though; it's a strategic move to guide new players, subtly highlighting where to click in the environment to get things started.

[b]Night Time Enhancements:[/b] Larger stands now look much better at night, thanks to an overlay makeover we undertook for the nighttime view. 

[h2]Behind the Counter 🧍‍♂️[/h2] 
The workers have been repositioned inside their vehicles while serving customers. This improvement is part of our commitment to enhancing the game's realism as much as possible. Except for the burger bike (they certainly can't be selling while sitting on the bike now, can they? 😆), you'll find all workers now serving from within their vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/818d4ba7204a95b42c13881fcc6dc58167934640.gif[/img]

[h2]Vehicle Upgrades View 🚚🔧[/h2] 
As for upgrades, we realized that knowing which one to buy and in an order that matches your goals might be a little tasking. So, we polished the vehicle upgrade view for clarity and simplicity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/dd540f52090396132683d4ae4d75d968086eafb1.gif[/img]
Now, the name and cost of the upgrade are listed beside each one, along with a '[i]Recommended[/i]' indicator to guide decision-making.

That's it for February! 🥂

notes.title: January Dev Diary - Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 👋

January has been an exciting start to the year. We hit the ground running, and we're bursting at the seams to share the latest updates with you.

Let's get right to it.

[i]TLDR: We've significantly improved the feedback, customer pathing, and inventory management systems. Plus, new researchable items for weather, pricing, and recipe perfection.[/i]

[u][h1]Gameplay Updates[/h1][/u]
[h2]Feedback System 👍👎[/h2]
Playtesters' feedback on this component brought some real issues to our attention. The main pain points were text readability, difficulty matching comments to stands, and identifying new feedback. 

Here's how the previous version looked:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/678813f6c6ae39705d8d3640c3140ed99069f895.gif[/img]

We've improved the layout to be more user-friendly and intuitive! Icons now represent stands, localities, and customer segments. 

We've included a counter for the latest feedback and bundled food and service quality feedback for each customer. This means less clutter and more insights at a glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/283e135092e7a66c38bcf13c18f13ee42b01f514.png[/img]

[h2]Customer Pathing 🛣️[/h2] 
The customer pathing system is how customers find their way around each locality. We designed it in such a way that they can find the shortest path to a stand. The image below shows the relevant aspects of the pathing system:[list]
[*] The stand is marked in red, with its range shown in transparent red.
[*] The path followed by customers is highlighted in blue, and the green squares mark intersection points where they can change direction.
[*] At the yellow decision point, customers decide whether to buy a burger based on their collision with the stand range.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8f691689c184fc0b2f201c5eb5b5874fcdc09736.jpg[/img]
Over time, we noticed that some stand spots, particularly those farther from customer path intersections, had lower foot traffic. We’ve moved two affected stand spots in [b]Noisy Playground[/b] and [b]Street Corner[/b] to improve their performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/cd421919a483bf48730cc89aa87fdca97e775f82.png[/img]
For Street Corner, it was a slightly bigger move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/511e6a7e331a3df694cbd3866978fc1fb73ab3eb.png[/img]
Additionally, we've optimized the intersection points to ensure better foot traffic across these stands in both locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/f49ad0a25a70138fd4352c24dfe3f6e3b577c0ed.png[/img]
After thoroughly testing business performance through different conditions, we will only know if these changes are effective.

[h2]Cold Storage & Ingredient Expiration 🧊[/h2] 
We've tweaked the cold storage and expiry functions to simplify ingredient management. Now, expiry only occurs when there's no cold storage.

In the latest design, just patty and cheese will expire when cold storage is unavailable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c9ad49564a5f2c5548c6fcd67890e9fb98cf75eb.png[/img]
When stored normally, patties and cheese expire after one day. However, when stored cold, they stay fresh indefinitely. 

[h2]Cursor Updates 🖱️[/h2] 
While implementing the tooltips, we added new cursor designs for items on the UI. Items with a tooltip now show a text box on hover, while clickable items show a pointing hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/40420174ccbb279028c91f0b4bb188a5c5fa037d.gif[/img]

[u][h1]New Research Items[/h1][/u]
[h2]Weather ⛈️🌦️[/h2] 
Weather Forecasting has become an exciting new feature you can unlock through research. Initially, you'll have access to the current weather conditions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/f700d926f2cef03172f9941abb4bedcfe689b115.gif[/img]
As you progress and research this feature, you'll gain the ability to see future weather forecasts.

[h2]Pricing Survey 💵👨‍👩‍👧‍👦[/h2] 
We've added a new, researchable pricing tool. The pricing survey helps you discover how likely your customers are to buy your burgers and drinks at current prices. Once unlocked, it's available once daily at a nominal fee. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/d214e8d3812cddc842242df8928ffd1ff4fc8662.png[/img]

[h2]Perfect Ingredient Feedback 🍅👍[/h2] 
The days of feeling like a mad scientist trying to figure out the perfect recipe are finally over! Many players voiced their struggles with this, and we listened!

Perfect Ingredients Feedback is our response to your requests. 

When you unlock this feature, customers will tell you when an ingredient amount in your recipe is just right. This feature promises to be a game-changer for discovering those perfect recipes.

That's it for January! 🥂

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: November Dev Diary - Stand Management Improvements
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 👋

[i]TLDR: We've completed the new City View UI, updated stands and worker management, and improved the system for upgrading and moving stands. The impact of training and salary on worker performance is more apparent, and vehicle upgrade now has a confirmation screen.[/i]

[h2]City & Locality Views[/h2]
We recently completed the new UI for the City View. Here is how it looks at night, with most features researched.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/f9b62b60b7956c6df61ce45ae3d7945810bfec8e.png[/img]

When you click on the locality button or anywhere in the environment while managing your stand, this screen will show all the stands in that area. 

We've made it easier to see empty spots and added quick-access buttons next to each stand. This is especially helpful at night, making stand management and movement more straightforward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/00a6c3ab2a31a880f37f9760f37d42693e215361.png[/img]

[h2]Worker Management[/h2]
Many playtesters understood the worker management system, but some missed essential details in the tooltips. These details include how training and salary affect how well workers do their jobs.

We've updated the worker management view to display vital information better. You can easily see how training and salary affect your workers' performance, helping you make better decisions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/daa25a6ff568e38eadf6bb9b73887a4b6f4aee85.png[/img]

Also, you can now research training options to make even more thoughtful choices about using your resources.

[h2]Vehicle & Upgrades[/h2]
Some players found it challenging to move their stands within and between different localities in the playtest. 

We've improved this process by adding a vehicle management section in the game. Now, upgrading, moving, and selling your stand are all in one place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/7257687660517abc4f0741aaafc33326b0103abc.png[/img]


[h2]Buying & Selling Upgrades[/h2]
Another area we improved was buying and selling stand upgrades. We noticed it wasn't clear that upgrades could be resold after 24 hours at a lower price.

Now, we've added a section for choosing upgrades. This shows what the upgrade does, how it will affect your business, and how much it costs. This makes it easier to understand and use the buy and sell feature in the upgrade system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/53e5b5d2c15cab31ba1936cae85796fa169cf98b.png[/img]

[h3]Confirm Before You Upgrade[/h3]
Now, when you upgrade your vehicle, there's a new confirmation screen to make sure it's what you want to do. 

This means no more accidental upgrades. 

Plus, you can see a side-by-side comparison of the old and new vehicle specs, helping you choose the best upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ccda156507eea8570bd5bf52ded9890819dba762.png[/img]

That's it for November!

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: October Dev Diary - Product Management Improvements
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 👋

In this update, we will be discussing the changes we've made to the game's product management system.

[i]TLDR: We've overhauled our product management system to show real-time burger count updates when recipes change. New researchable features offer pricing insights into customer preferences and an inventory calculator for efficient business management. Inventory sees a unified view for both normal and cold storage, the introduction of an expiry mechanic for ingredients, and revised storage size for an added gameplay challenge.[/i]

We found out during our playtests that players had no problem changing burger recipes. However, they had a hard time predicting how those changes would impact their inventory the next day.

Because of this, players often ran out of stock earlier than planned. The latest product management design intends to fix these issues by providing players with more relevant information right where they need it.

[h2]Product Management 2.0[/h2]
We used to have three screens for product management. One was for recipes and pricing. Another was for burger inventory. The last was for drinks. 📋

This setup sometimes missed key links 🔗, like the tie between recipes and current stock. 🍔📦 Now, we've updated it to show four related tabs:
[list]
[*] Recipe 📜
[*] Prices 💵
[*] Inventory 📦
[*] Ordering 🛒
[/list]
[h3]Recipe Management 📜[/h3]
The recipe section now shows how many burgers you can make with each ingredient you have. Change an ingredient in your recipe? The number of burgers changes right away. 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8d0d8f7fd90a4970574561fa692e0bf138053104.png[/img]

Plus, we added a new save feature 💾 for recipes. You can save and swap recipes easily 🔄, depending on your strategy.

[h3]Price Management 💵[/h3]
We've added a new, researchable feature for pricing: "purchase probability insights" 📊. This helps you set the right price for different customers 👥. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/91bc3114d7c6e1d820267c2643de1c7e703b4250.png[/img]

Before, you only saw pricing effects after the day began 🌅. Now, with this new section, you get an estimate. You'll see how likely each customer group is to buy based on your set price 🏷️.

[h3]Inventory Management 📦[/h3]
The inventory section has major updates 🔄. Before, there were separate screens for normal and cold storage 🌡️. Players couldn't easily see which ingredient took up the most space, making stock planning a bit difficult 😤. Finally, we didn't have the product expiry mechanic.

Now, things have changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/6d8b823e62c1820b61ee9759798bc27c12c9e6d2.png[/img]

Normal and cold storage are together in one view, and ingredients are now organized by storage priority. Cold storage is now researchable.

[b]Expiry Mechanic:[/b] Cold storage ❄️ helps your patties and cheese last longer 🍔🧀. Without it, they go bad in a day. With it? They're good for up to three days!

We've also revamped the storage indicators for improved visibility, allowing players to gauge the space occupied by individual ingredients swiftly.

Lastly, we've made the default storage smaller. Previously, storage management was not a big part of the gameplay mechanic. That’s because the storage was too large to be a consideration.

We hope the smaller storage will make for a fun twist that ramps up the challenge and tests your resource management skills.

[h3]Ordering Management 🛒[/h3]
We've restructured the ordering procedure to ensure a more streamlined and intuitive gaming experience 🕹️. 

[b]Clear Quantity Signs[/b]: It's now easy to see how many ingredients you need. We relocated quantity details from within the tooltips to more prominent positions to avoid oversight and facilitate informed decision-making.

[b]New Ordering Button[/b]: In the previous version, replenishing your inventory required you to start a new day 🌅. Now, we've separated the 'Order' function from the 'Start Day' button, enabling a more logical and intuitive end to your ordering process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/378b30abe5323285db952adb6bb803aedbd91b9b.png[/img]

[b]Inventory Calculator[/b]: The inventory calculator is a researchable item that can help you manage your business more easily. 

With this calculator, you can quickly compute the required purchase orders for burger production, saving you time and reducing manual calculations. As your business grows, this tool will become indispensable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/e8eeb18f0956f5bdd18db14431d499ae913aeae9.png[/img]

That's it for this update!

We'd leave you with Laz's attempt to recover from a disastrous financial position on his journey to hitting $250,000 in cold hard cash!

[previewyoutube=wpZz8xj2ST8;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: Getting Product Development Right 👍🍔
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 👋

[quote=author]Want to playtest 🕹️🎮 the game? We are running a playtest right now! 🕺💃 [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]Join our community[/url] and embrace the challenge in Business Heroes: Food Truck Simulation! 😉 [/quote]
It is no secret that the foundation of a food truck business’s success lies in the quality of its food. But the question remains, how do entrepreneurs develop a recipe that delights their customers and keeps them returning for more?

In this edition, we delve into the inner workings of the product development process and how we designed the feedback system to help players perfect their recipes.

[h1]Discovering Customer Needs 🍔[/h1]
There are nine customer segments in the city. Each group has unique preferences for its burger. The player's food quality goal is to discover the perfect recipe for their target customer segment.

During our second playtest, we discovered that giving players a preferred range for the perfect recipe of each customer segment drastically improved their playthrough.

We added this range in the tooltip of each customer segment:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/0c0c2c09798c0c7ccf067e12fb42b23c6fd6da46.gif[/img]

The perfect recipe for all customer segments changes with each game, but the preference range stays the same.

The recipe has five ingredients with a minimum and maximum amount that can be included per burger:

[b]Patty[/b]: 100g - 300g per burger.
[b]Tomato slices[/b]: 0 - 5 slices per burger.
[b]Lettuce leaves[/b]: 0 - 5 leaves per burger.
[b]Cheese slices[/b]: 0 - 5 slices per burger.
[b]Sauce[/b]: 0 - 3 sachets per burger.

Depending on the player's target customer segment, they can use the preference range to decide their initial ingredient combo and modify it based on customer feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/420edf79ec7f55b4d36c5da0ac5ea45a700f72ca.gif[/img]

[h1]Feedback Interpretation 👩‍🏫[/h1]
We implemented a recipe feedback interpretation system to help you know exactly how much more or fewer ingredients your burger needs.

Customers give one of four types of food quality feedback whenever they buy a burger:
[list]
[*] [b]Terrible burger[/b] - Yuck!
[*] [b]Excess ingredient[/b] - The burger is overloaded.
[*] [b]Insufficient ingredient[/b] - The burger is empty.
[*] [b]Perfect recipe[/b]
[/list]
Their feedback depends on the margin of difference between their perfect recipe and the number of ingredients in the burger they just bought.

Let’s take tomato slices, for example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/60f50d2fbd29c3e67a067b744de79678b5ecdd74.png[/img]

In the above example, 2 tomato slices are perfect for the customer segment. When no tomatoes are added to the recipe, the customer will give an 'Insufficient' ingredient feedback, meaning the slices should be increased by 2.

If 4 slices are added, the customer will give an ‘Excessive’ ingredient feedback, meaning the tomato slices should be reduced by 2.

When 5 slices are added, the customer will give a ‘Terrible Burger’ feedback, meaning the tomato slices should be reduced by 3.

Whenever the customer does not give food quality feedback, the ingredients are close to the perfect recipe and only require one increment or reduction.

[h1]Feedback Prioritization ⬆⬇[/h1]
Because the recipe feedback applies to all ingredients and we only wanted to show one per customer purchase, we had to prioritize them.

Terrible burger has the highest priority. Hence if any ingredient in the recipe meets that condition, the customer will give a terrible burger feedback, even if all other ingredients are excessive or insufficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/678813f6c6ae39705d8d3640c3140ed99069f895.gif[/img]

Excess ingredient is next in priority, but only when there is an equal number of Insufficient ingredient feedback in the recipe. If either feedback is more in the recipe, it will show as the recipe feedback.

For instance, if a recipe has an excess of 2 ingredients and an insufficiency of 2 ingredients, the feedback shown is for 'Excess' ingredients.

But if a recipe has an insufficiency of 2 ingredients and an excess of 1, then the feedback shown is for 'Insufficient' ingredient.

We hope this prioritization will eliminate confusion, allow players to quickly resolve their recipe's most severe problems, and get them closer to the perfect recipe faster.

That's it for this episode!

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: Simulating Economic Roller Coasters
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Today we are taking you behind the scenes to see how we generate economic cycles in the game. 😀

Let's dive right in!

[h1]The Importance of Adaptability[/h1]
Successful entrepreneurship requires adaptability—the ability to roll with unexpected punches capable of knocking out your best-laid plans. 

Imagine starting out as a food truck entrepreneur. You've carefully selected the best location, perfected your menu, and are just beginning to get into the flow of things. But just weeks into your launch, the economy takes a nose dive. 

Suddenly, your carefully crafted plans and projections go up in smoke, and you are left scrambling to save your business.

This is a scenario many entrepreneurs have faced at some point, and the ability to quickly adapt their business strategy to unexpected economic realities is often what differentiates successful businesses from the rest. 

[h1]Simulating Economic Impact[/h1]
We decided to simulate the same phenomenon in the game to allow you to flex your strategic-thinking skills. Each city in the game has a different difficulty level based on many factors, including its economic situation 📉.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5a7245c787087beb25115d77c505a46b0ecf0afb.gif[/img]

Like in real life, each city's economy in the game experiences business cycles of economic growth and downturn. Although an average cycle lasts about ten years, we thought it would be fun to implement business cycles in the game as one-year rotations 😎.

The city has nine customer segments with unique spending limits and habits. Their perceived value of your burger 🍔 & drink 🥤 increases or decreases depending on the economic situation.

Here's how we designed it.

[h1]The Design[/h1]
Let's take Washington DC, as an example. The graph below shows the annual GDP growth for the US. Despite the micro tremors, the overall 10-year cycle is unmistakable. ⬇️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/82a0060cf10b5d3bf930851165d9cc204248bcb0.png[/img]

For our simulation, we picked the US's ten-year average GDP growth rate (2%) to generate the base case scenario of the economy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/863f0f023d328983164b47c59b8c7542c7d6c989.png[/img]

The graph below illustrates the outcome of the formula.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/6c6744b548fe43466144d352d7be80c731d5e0e3.jpg[/img]

As you strive to grow your business, the economic growth percentage will move across the blue dotted line to simulate economic growth or slow down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/3e4682ea0d9859625dc4942692c14728ff711c4e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/643effaca7acd5f9a7a844fa74be14ccafe67666.jpg[/img]

Real economies also experience unexpected spikes and dips in the business cycle. We catered to this by implementing an events mechanic.

Based on the probability of occurrence, events such as technological breakthroughs 💻, international sports events 🏈, or trade wars and taxes will feed the simulation with spikes and dips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c11a0c60692d21c7aad1f0e8b02d0d233190d029.jpg[/img]

[h1]In-game Impact[/h1]
How does this impact the game? The population size is divided into [i]outdoor[/i] and [i]base[/i] population sizes. The outdoor population size is the total number of customers that are outdoors and willing to make a purchase. The base population size is the total number of customers, including those indoors.

The economic situation influences the outdoor population size. Many or fewer customers are willing to come out and spend depending on if the economy is in a growth phase or a downturn.

Each segment has a Base Economic Happiness, e.g. 40 units. Their current economic happiness per time will fluctuate upwards ↗️ or downwards ↘️ depending on the current economic condition.

Example of the calculation for the Parent segment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/48f486788fda540d45a679625235283b6d3341bc.png[/img]

Y generates the current economic happiness 😄 value of the Parent segment. You can see the difference between the outdoor and base population size as well as the current and base economic happiness in the customer segment tooltip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/378ecdb4373f08994d7760a0a2ba5bbcfb4fb433.gif[/img]

Less population leads to fewer sales for your business ☹️. You will need to strategize, adjust your price, increase your marketing spending and improve your burger quality to drive sales. Additionally, having enough savings to weather the hard times really helps. 😉

That's it for this episode!

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: From Rainy Days to Sunny Skies: Simulating Real City Weather Conditions 🌨️⛈️
notes.content:
Food truck owners expect to face a variety of challenges daily. But perhaps one of the biggest challenges they face is terrible weather. Keeping the truck open and customers satisfied can be extra demanding when it's freezing or pouring outside. 

This episode is about how we designed the game's weather system to simulate city-specific weather conditions.

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]
As you know, there are several major cities in the game. To improve the player experience and game difficulty, we had to ensure that each city's in-game weather mirrors the historical weather conditions of their real-life counterpart.

Getting this right was quite the challenge. 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8c45fd631a799b22df3fba8206848733aded3211.gif[/img]

[h1]Solution[/h1]
We first tried to implement a replica of historical weather conditions in each city. But we quickly realized this would pose a problem with replayability as players would eventually find our data source 😨 and have an unfair advantage on the leaderboards.

So we decided to discard this method. 🚮

Our second and final approach was to use the normal distribution and the average temperature and precipitation values in a city to generate the weather condition. For example, let's take Washington, DC, as a case study.

Below is the actual data for Washington, DC:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/68bb70232dc4a7a191daa39915b0da9cf38627b1.jpg[/img]

By taking the average temperature as a mean and using a standard deviation of one, we randomly generated the temperature to fit within the high and low ranges. The [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box%E2%80%93Muller_transform]Box–Muller transform[/url] was particularly useful here.

This method helped us account for the rare occurrence of a very high 🥵 or very low 🥶 temperature, which happens in reality. Similarly, for the precipitation, we used the average as a mean and a standard deviation of two to generate the amount of rain 🌧️, which directs the cloud volume. ☁️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8b84d1c1e552301af4dd3e1a277c404f55d8d4b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5d7b299c8a78d5fd35f7a3a2a1a7c3156a180abf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/a07006c39972d0e52911d9cc0034a15650613d52.jpg[/img]

[h1]Result[/h1]
You can observe a clear jump ⬆️ in averages as we move from month to month, which shouldn’t be so. To resolve this, we employed weekly peak averages instead of monthly, which made it work as intended.

Below is a yearly temperature simulation for Washington DC for the morning 🌅, afternoon 🕑, and evening 🌆.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/b1f8a683fbd44f9617bc133e3c64b8d0029eb491.jpg[/img]

The simulation for the rain/cloud below is for the mornings alone in Washington, DC. As you can see, most mornings, there is a light shower or an overcast, followed by sunny conditions and light rain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/acece034c8aadb330484276caf8b18c3cd4dcb35.jpg[/img]

We think this method strikes the right balance between fun 🕺💃 and computing requirements. 💻

[h1]In-game impact[/h1]
The presence of rain ☔ and snow 🌨️ reduces the outdoor population in the game, thus reducing the number of sales possible during the period, just like in real life. You can always invest in upgrades to reduce the impact of weather on your business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/da5eba84e79d3d7d26956ff975fc5fedeeaecd49.gif[/img]

However, it might not be a profitable investment if your chosen customer segment is not big enough. It will take strategic thinking 🤔 and astute decision-making to discern the best time for such an investment.

That's it for this episode!

Don't forget to [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url] to get these behind-the-scenes specials delivered directly to your inbox. Plus, we've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

Live Long and Prosper 👋,
[b]Team Visionaries[/b]

notes.title: Progress Update: Inventory Management and Automation
notes.content:
Hello Business Heroes,

Welcome to our latest progress update. While we’ve been spending a tremendous amount of time just debugging the financials section😭, we still managed to get work done on the Inventory section for Burgers. Have a look.

[h1]Burger Inventory 🍔[/h1]

The Burger Inventory section is where you manage all the stock you need for your burgers - Buns, Patties, Tomatoes, Lettuce, Cheese, and Sauces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8707e546da1012ef476ec56bcc5a1e81d8e4550c.gif[/img]

A quick run down of the various sections:

[b]Stock (Total)[/b] - Helps you track how much of each ingredient you have left in stock and your new total (in brackets) after you make an order.

[b]Next Day’s Purchase Order[/b] - Where you order how much of each ingredient you need for the next business day.

[b]Burger Counter[/b] - Shows the number of burgers you can make with your current ingredient inventory size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/e9feca27e65e0ce147de4b9c49d458c533f1df3d.png[/img]

[i]Side Note: Whenever an ingredient is not enough for the number of buns you are ordering, the stock total stays red. It turns green when it’s enough.[/i]

[b]Daily Cost and Excess Loss[/b] - Daily cost is the amount your next day’s order costs. Excess loss is the cost of all wasted ingredients. Ingredients get wasted when you order after your storage is full.

[b]Storage Capacity[/b] - The brown bar represents how much storage your total stock has used up and how much is left.

[h1]Drinks 🥤[/h1]
The drinks on offer in the game are a combination of water, soda, and juice. They serve as a complementary product that your business may sell to customers to increase revenue. The inventory management for drinks works nearly the same way as that for burgers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ff85f1ee2d41ca3720e4c376e47e78f940123af2.gif[/img]

Unlike burgers, however, drinks are not your business’s primary product. They require your food truck to be equipped with a cooler box or fridge before you can sell them. 

Depending on the type you own, you can equip your food truck with a cooler box or fridge by going to the add-ons section (where all the equipment upgrades are for your food truck are).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/7f04f66644e0235bbd075f1844432f6f0f4dd6bd.gif[/img]

[i]Side note: Upgrades that have the padlock symbol on them indicate that they are not compatible with your food truck.[/i] 

After equipping your food truck with a means of cold storage, you can begin to sell drinks to your customers. Notice in the image above that some fridges also increase the shelf life of burgers and ingredients. 

Be sure to keep an eye on your storage consumption, though. Drinks ordered after your cold storage is at full capacity will go to waste. And we certainly do not want that. 😉

[h1]Auto-stock 🤖[/h1]
Inventory management is one of the activities you will be carrying out daily to ensure you have enough stock for the next day. You will frequently have to increase or decrease your stock to avoid buying more or less than what you need. For Burger Inventory, this means managing quantities for all your ingredients individually.

As you expand, it’s only normal that you will want to automate your inventory process. We implemented a pay-per-use solution called Auto-stock to provide this automation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c20051566838d822f74451358e22ca6a74c2ab07.png[/img]

With one click, auto-stock helps you calculate the quantity of ingredients you require for the number of buns you have in stock. This way, you can quickly balance your order quantity across multiple stands, save time, and avoid overspending on inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ff74dc26be84acfbe72761d16791c1f9828b38cd.gif[/img]

You will pay a fee every time you use the auto-stock function, so keep an eye on your account balance when you use it. If you are running low on cash, you can always manage your stock manually. 😊

After implementing this function, we were impressed with its impact on the gameplay experience. We are sure you’d appreciate the convenience it introduces to your business management activities when you can afford to use it.
